items.title: Gucci Names Park Bo-gum Global Brand Face
items.summary: Jing Daily's China-luxury-trade recap of Park Bo-gum's Nov 5 appointment as Gucci global ambassador, noting his prior Gucci looks at the Baeksang Arts Awards and on the W Korea cover, and framing the move within Gucci's broader push to court Korean/Chinese fan-driven demand. No reach or engagement data provided.

items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Vogue Korea feature on Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey under creative director Demna, including her private New York store appearance where a choir performed her Christmas hit. Carey is quoted calling the shoot genuinely enjoyable, a scene with a dog memorable.

items.title: Park Bo-gum sheds his 'brash heartthrob' persona... decadent allure explodes
items.summary: Coverage of Park Bo-gum's Gucci ambassador debut imagery -- tousled hair, brown leather jacket, backward Gucci cap -- describing a deliberate break from his usual clean-cut image, with netizen reactions calling it a 'bad boy sexy' turn quoted in the piece.

items.title: Fan reaction thread to Park Bo-gum's Gucci ambassador reveal photos
items.summary: Korean fan-account X post reacting to Park Bo-gum's Gucci debut photos, describing the in-person impact of his features; part of a broader wave of fan posts pushing #ParkBoGum and Gucci hashtags on release day. Representative of organic SNS buzz rather than brand-owned content.

items.title: Has Gucci proved Made in China has a long way to go?
items.summary: Critical analysis of Gucci's 'Made in China' labeled Drip sneaker (designed by Demna), arguing the open label is 'dividing the internet' and testing whether Chinese manufacturing can shed its discount image within luxury. Cited as still-relevant background to the ongoing debate since no newer dedicated piece surfaced this week.

items.source: KSL (wire, Made in China sneaker story)
items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Analyst-sourced piece (Berenberg, Barclays, consultant Simon Whitehouse) warning Gucci's China-made Drip sneaker and related price cuts create tension between provenance and luxury positioning; Whitehouse quoted calling the label 'not a good look.' Included for critical-angle balance; older but still actively cited/recirculated in Nov threads.

items.source: Weibo (奢侈品解读 account, templated FAQ post)
items.title: 消费者对Gucci中国制造鞋接受度怎么样？
items.summary: Weibo FAQ-style post summarizing polarized Chinese consumer sentiment on the Made-in-China Drip sneaker: roughly 40% calling it 'too radical,' 30% 'finally interesting,' 30% neutral/watching; cites a product-development-linked blogger reporting a 3% return rate on a sold-out first batch. Treated as lower-confidence aggregator content (templated account, numbers unverifiable against primary source) per bot-filter guidance -- included only for directional sentiment signal.

items.title: 古驰官网永久降价最高40%撞上酒神回收只剩2-4k
items.summary: Chinese deal/community site post warning shoppers ahead of Double 11 that Gucci's permanent official price cuts (up to 40%, e.g. Mercato tote and Ophidia/Marmont mini bags) have crashed secondhand resale and trade-in values (Dionysus bags down from 20,000+ to 3,000-5,000 yuan), citing 12 consecutive quarters of sales decline and a CEO admission that prices were too high.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 오늘자 얼굴...jpg
items.summary: Korean community (theqoo) thread sharing photos of Park Bo-gum at the Gucci-presented LACMA Art+Film Gala, his first public appearance since the ambassador announcement; comment sentiment largely positive on his styling, continuing engagement into this week.

items.title: 근데 왜 다들 구찌 싫어해..?
items.summary: Long-running Korean community discussion thread asking why Gucci is widely disliked/seen as declassed among young Korean consumers; representative of a persistent 'overexposed, not exclusive enough' critical narrative that resurfaces whenever Gucci is in the news (e.g. alongside this week's ambassador coverage). Exact post date not recoverable from search cache; included for recurring sentiment context, not as a dated news event.

items.title: グッチ ビューティの口コミ一覧
items.summary: Japanese beauty-review community aggregating consumer reviews of Gucci Beauty fragrance lines; overall tone positive ('upscale, long-lasting scent') with some noting heavier formulations suit autumn/winter use, timed around the brand's Nov 4 holiday coffret launch. Useful as ongoing product-sentiment community signal distinct from campaign press coverage.

items.title: 如何评价Gucci近年的设计风格？
items.summary: Long-running Zhihu Q&A thread on how to assess Gucci's recent design direction, resurfacing in discussion threads tied to Demna's debut and the Made-in-China sneaker controversy; mixed views on whether Demna's Balenciaga-style aesthetic fits Gucci's heritage. Included as community sentiment context; not a dated news item.

items.title: 山田涼介が「グッチ」のフレンド オブ ハウスに仲間入り
items.summary: Background reference piece on Japanese actor Yamada Ryosuke joining Gucci's 'Friend of the House' roster and visiting the Isetan Shinjuku pop-up; included only as prior-ambassador context for Japan given no fresher Japan-specific Gucci personality news surfaced this week. Flagged as stale relative to the 72-hour target.

items.title: 韓시장서 경영체제 변화 준 명품 구찌, 실적개선 돌파구 찾을까
items.summary: Korean business-press analysis of whether Gucci's Korea unit can find an earnings turnaround following its creative-director change, noting Gucci Korea's limited-liability-company status means it no longer discloses local financial results, so its Korea performance must be inferred from global figures (Q3 global comparable sales down 6%).

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 구찌 컬렉션, 패션 전문가들의 반응?
items.summary: WWD Korea trade roundup of fashion-expert reactions to Demna's first full Gucci collection, cited as ongoing reference point in this week's renewed Demna/Gucci design-direction discussion threads on Zhihu and in Korean community posts.

notes: DC Inside produced no fresh item within the window for this run (yesterday's made-in-China mockery thread, 2026-11-09, was already pooled on 2026-11-11 and not re-itemized to avoid cross-date duplication); Naver Blog/Cafe and Xiaohongshu searches returned no on-topic indexed posts today despite being Priority-A community/sns sources -- genuinely dry, not padded. Several Weibo 'comos' account posts show templated/mass-identical FAQ phrasing per source-pool-policy bot-filter criteria; only one such post was retained (NEA-007) for directional sentiment and is flagged low-confidence rather than treated as load-bearing. Critical-angle searches (price hikes, Made-in-China backlash, resale-value drop, 'why does everyone hate Gucci') surfaced real material (NEA-005, 006, 007, 008, 010) alongside the heavily positive Park Bo-gum ambassador wave (NEA-001 through 004, 009) -- pool is not purely activation coverage, but positive ambassador/campaign items still outnumber critical items roughly 2:1 this cycle.
